# Lumela 0.1.3

Safer auto redact, and updates that reach you on their own.

## What's new

- **API keys that wrap onto the next line are now covered.** Auto redact used to look at one line at a time, so the tail of a long key that wrapped stayed visible, and a key split into two short halves was missed. Thanks to the person who asked about this on X.
- **Linux: text recognition no longer mixes up images.** Two OCR runs at the same time could read each other's image. Each run now uses its own temporary file.
- **Updates while Lumela sits in the tray.** Lumela now checks for a new version at launch and every few hours, and tells you once per version. Updating is still one click and up to you: it downloads, checks the signature, installs and restarts.
- **Linux `.deb`:** the update button now opens the release page, because a `.deb` cannot replace itself. The AppImage updates in place.
- **README in 简体中文, 日本語 and 한국어.**

## Download

| Your system | Download |
|---|---|
| **Windows 10 / 11** | `Lumela_0.1.3_x64-setup.exe` (recommended) or `Lumela_0.1.3_x64_en-US.msi` |
| **macOS** (Apple silicon and Intel) | `Lumela_0.1.3_universal.dmg` |
| **Linux** (x64): Ubuntu 24.04+, Debian 13+, Fedora 40+ or similar | `Lumela_0.1.3_amd64.AppImage` or `Lumela_0.1.3_amd64.deb` |

If you already have Lumela 0.1.0 or 0.1.1, it updates itself.

### First launch

Installers are not code-signed yet, so the operating system warns on first launch.

- **Windows:** *More info* → *Run anyway*.
- **macOS 15 and later:** open Lumela once and close the warning, then **System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**. Installing with Homebrew skips this step.
